projects.name: Technical Support Executive
details: Technical Support Executive
Benchmark, Gurugram | February 2022 – May 2023
- Supported cloud-based SaaS applications and assisted in Workfront-related administrative tasks, including user setup,
permissions management, and minor workflow maintenance.
- Provided customer assistance with API troubleshooting, workflow automation, and data sync issues across multiple systems.
- Helped maintain Workfront documentation and reporting templates, contributing to improved internal efficiency and user
experience.
- Supported email deliverability (SPF , DKIM, DMARC) and managed integrations between various platforms.
